title: bugs in tag omission
body: 1. `body` and `bgsound`, `basefont`, `base`, `title`. From spec: > A [body](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-body-element) element's [start tag](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-start-tag) can be omitted if the element is empty, or if the first thing inside the [body](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-body-element) element is not [ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) or a [comment](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-comments), except if the first thing inside the [body](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-body-element) element is a [meta](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-meta-element), [link](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-link-element), [script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-script-element), [style](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-style-element), or [template](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-template-element) element. There are more tags, missing cases - `bgsound`, `basefont`, `base` and `title`. Example for `title` (but the same bug for other tag): Input: ```html X ``` DOM: ``` | | | | | | "X" ``` Because we miss `title` in spec our output is: Output: ```html <!doctype html><title>X ``` DOM: ``` | | | | | "X" | <body> ``` 2. `p` and tables and adoption algorithm From spec: > A [p](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-p-element) element's [end tag](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if the [p](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-p-element) element is immediately followed by an [address](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-address-element), [article](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-article-element), [aside](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-aside-element), [blockquote](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-blockquote-element), [details](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-details-element), [div](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-div-element), [dl](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-dl-element), [fieldset](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-fieldset-element), [figcaption](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-figcaption-element), [figure](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-figure-element), [footer](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-footer-element), [form](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-form-element), [h1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements), [h2](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements), [h3](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements), [h4](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements), [h5](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements), [h6](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements), [header](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-header-element), [hgroup](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-hgroup-element), [hr](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-hr-element), [main](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-main-element), [menu](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-menu-element), [nav](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-nav-element), [ol](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-ol-element), [p](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-p-element), [pre](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-pre-element), [section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-section-element), [table](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-table-element), or [ul](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-ul-element) element, or if there is no more content in the parent element and the parent element is an [HTML element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#html-elements) th[a](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-a-element)t is not an a, [audio](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-audio-element), [del](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-del-element), [ins](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-ins-element), [map](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-map-element), [noscript](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-noscript-element), or [video](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-video-element) element, or an [autonomous custom element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#autonomous-custom-element). Here two bugs: - `table` can't be here - Adoption agency algorithm and reconstruct active elements `Table` bug: Input: ```html <table><a>1<p>2</a>3</p> ``` DOM: ``` | <html> | <head> | <body> | <a> | "1" | <p> | <a> | "2" | "3" | <table> ``` Output with omitting `p` for `table`: ```html <a>1</a><p><a>2</a>3<table></table> ``` DOM: ``` | <html> | <head> | <body> | <a> | "1" | <p> | <a> | "2" | "3" | <table> ``` And now `table` inside `p` and DOM is not the same. Adoption agency algorithm and reconstruct active elements: Input: ```html <b><b><a><p></a> ``` DOM: ``` | <html> | <head> | <body> | <b> | <b> | <a> | <p> | <a> ``` Output with omitting `p` for `b`: Output: ``` <b><b><a></a><p><a></a></b></b> ``` DOM: ``` | <html> | <head> | <body> | <b> | <b> | <a> | <p> | <b> | <b> | <a> ``` And as you can see DOM is not the same. I think we miss here all elements from adoption logic, i.e.:(except self void) ``` An end tag whose tag name is one of: "a", "b", "big", "code", "em", "font", "i", "nobr", "s", "small", "strike", "strong", "tt", "u" ``` --- Note - these cases only for omitting cases, if we will seriliaze these cases without omitting logic (i.e. with start and end tags) all is fine, no bugs. All tests from https://github.com/html5lib/html5lib-tests and I implemented cross testing to catch these cases i.e. `parse` -> `create pseudo DOM` (as below) -> `serialize` -> `parse again` -> `check we have the same AST as before` -> `create pseudo DOM again and check we have the same DOM as before`.
